title: Google justifies its massive AI spending with a booming cloud business
slides: Can Google's AI spending actually pay off?
Cloud revenue surged 30% this quarter alone
But AI costs are growing even faster than revenue
Your next cloud bill may soon rise unexpectedly
Audit your AI usage before costs spiral out
thread_text:
1. The hidden cost of AI

Google's cloud revenue jumped 30% last quarter, but AI infrastructure costs are climbing faster.

2. Revenue vs. spending gap

AI costs are rising at a rate that outpaces even the fastest-growing revenue streams.

3. Your bill is next

Cloud providers will pass these rising costs to you — expect an unexpected hike soon.

4. Why now matters

Companies that don't track AI usage risk budget blowouts before they see the warning signs.

5. One move to make today

Run an audit of your AI tools this week — find out which ones are worth the cost before it's too late.
